subject: genetic map using SSR and SNP loci

messages.author: 9af7c0e584af0222
messages.subject: genetic map using SSR and SNP loci
parts:
Dear Dr Karl,

I have few doubts,

1) We have genotypic data of 200 SSRs and 1000 SNPs. Earlier we did genetic mapping using SSR based genetic map in which we got significant LOD and phenotypic variance. Again we constructed the genetic map for the same population using 1000 SNPs and we perform QTL analysis but the LOD and phenotypic variance is coming less as compare to SSR based genetic map. What could be the reason?

1) Can we develop an integrated genetic map using 200 SSRs and 1000 SNPs? 


Thanks

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] genetic map using SSR and SNP loci
parts:
Dear Sir,
We have done the genotyping microarray. Suppose SNP1 (T/G) we have scored (A/B) where, T allele is present in A parent and G is in B parent. Similarly using SSRs we have two alleles (A/B). So data is biallelic for all SSRs and SNPs.

Thanks & Regards,
Sunil Gangurde
Research Scholar
Centre of Excellence In Genomics and Systems Biology (CEGSB)
